up: Return the exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1613910. For each matching activity, include the ChEMBL ID of the compound, the canonical SMILES of the compound, the standard type, the standard relation, the standard value, and the standard units.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE a.assay_id = (SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613910')
